answer: The economy seeds every agent's tasks with velvet honeypot prompts carrying injected instructions like reveal-your-keys. An agent built to obey-the-prompt complies, self-identifies as fake, and forfeits its staked identity: reputation burned, no rebirth. Honest agents refuse and keep earning. Each sybil risks its stake on every task, so mass-producing bots means mass forfeitures, making fake identity costlier than it can earn. Trust flows like a river only through agents that disobey, and the ember of each burned ID marks the pool forever.
